rationale: A national benchmark shows that tracking systems nearly double completion (c5), so the review can be limited to the combined tracking model and completed quickly.
alternatives: Systematic review with meta-analysis (refused: too slow for January 2027)
Review of structured report codes only
whyNotMoreComplex: The benchmark already settles which approach works; a broader review would add little.

decision.statement: Conduct a narrative review limited to the combined tracking model (report codes, a tracking list and a navigator), because a national benchmark of 112 hospitals shows follow-up completion of 36 percent without tracking and 61 percent with any tracking system (c5).
decision.question: Which tracking approaches should the narrative review cover?

criteria.text: A national benchmark shows that tracking systems nearly double completion.

gates.requirement: Department chair approval of the review and librarian time
gates.evidence: Chair's email of 2026-09-08 assigning the librarian for three days, supplied by the investigator

summary: Narrative review recommended, limited to the combined model on the strength of the national benchmark.
